name: e-invoicing-tr-profile-ids
title: UBL-TR scenario / ProfileID codes (e-Fatura)
description: The ProfileID values that identify the business process of a Turkish e-document (e-Fatura, e-Arşiv Fatura, e-İrsaliye), with their official Turkish descriptions from the GİB code list and which UBL-TR schematron ProfileID lists accept each value.

sources.title: UBL-TR Kod Listeleri, Versiyon 1.43, Temmuz 2026 (section 2.2 Senaryo / ProfileID), in UBLTR_1.2.1_Kilavuzlar.zip, Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı, retrieved 2026-11-16

e-Fatura Paketi, schematron/UBL-TR_Codelist.xml (ProfileIDType, ProfileIDTypeEarchive, ProfileIDTypeDespatchAdvice, ProfileIDTypeGoruntuleme; package history up to 2026-07-01), Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı, retrieved 2026-11-16: used for schematron_lists

fields.name: code
fields.description: Value written to cbc:ProfileID (and the equivalent on despatch advice).

fields.name: name
fields.description: Turkish description as printed in section 2.2 of the code list guide.

fields.name: schematron_lists
fields.description: Semicolon-separated UBL-TR schematron lists that accept the code: invoice (ProfileIDType), earchive (ProfileIDTypeEarchive), despatch (ProfileIDTypeDespatchAdvice), display (ProfileIDTypeGoruntuleme). Empty when the guide lists the code but no schematron list accepts it.
